author: Jake Kanter
title: 'Mark and I strongly disagree with their characterisation': Facebook's Sheryl Sandberg snaps back at Apple CEO Tim Cook in simmering data row (FB, AAPL)
text: 'Mark and I strongly disagree with their characterisation': Facebook's Sheryl Sandberg snaps back at Apple CEO Tim Cook in simmering data row (FB, AAPL) By Jake Kanter May 30, 2018, 7:33 am 29 pts Facebook COO Sheryl Sandberg said she "strongly disagrees" with Apple CEO Tim Cook's barbs about Facebook's approach to user privacy. Cook has made much of Apple's "respectful" approach to personal information since the Cambridge Analytica scandal and has said Facebook is "beyond" regulation.…
